purpose: N0 data-provenance gate: are the teacher labels, sampler and checkpoints all post-fix?
question: Did the fairness fixes (planned-move leak, executed-move semantics) precede the artefacts in use?

raw_trajectories.evidence: collection.json settings carry schema/encoding revisions; the adapter that wrote them no longer exports observed_move

teacher_labels.produced_by: scripts: stsai collect under the patched engine
teacher_labels.note: labels are produced by the same adapter build as the observations, so the leak fix covers them

checkpoint_init.reason: no contaminated checkpoint is ever resumed from in this round

sampler_audit.finding: PilotBattle::sample copies the battle including moveHistory[0], the not-yet-executed planned move.
code_path: Monster::rollMove calls getMoveForRoll BEFORE setMove shifts the history
getMoveForRoll therefore reads moveHistory[0] as the move JUST EXECUTED, which the player watched resolve
the planned move only becomes an AI input once it has been executed and is public

other_hidden_move_inputs.GREMLIN_WIZARD: monsterData charge flag; the charging state is visible as the intent
other_hidden_move_inputs.RED_SLAVER: miscInfo usedEntangle flag; whether Entangle was used is public

sampler_audit.why_not_proven: a decisive test needs two live states with identical full public history but a different hidden planned move; scanning all 2104 stored development states found no public-state collision across episodes, so no such pair could be constructed
sampler_audit.residual_assumption: an executed move is identifiable after the fact from its visible consequences; two moves with literally identical consequences would make it private and this audit would not catch it

gate_result: PASS with the residual assumption above recorded; no privileged-teacher labels are mixed into the main comparison
